name: Should I hire separate specialists or a single remodeling contractor for interior repairs?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire separate specialists or a single remodeling contractor for interior repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general remodeling and finish contractor is better than hiring separate trade specialists when repairs involve multiple surfaces, such as drywall, baseboards, paint, and tile. Hiring a painter, a finish carpenter, and a tile installer separately leads to conflicting schedules, multiple minimum service fees, and gaps in accountability for blending finishes. HH Remodeling LLC manages carpentry, drywall patching, and interior painting under a single on-site lead, providing a seamless transition between framing or trim work and final paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single finish contractor is best when repairs span multiple materials like drywall, trim, and tile, saving you from juggling multiple trade fees and schedules.
